source.relationship: independent community research; not a MiniMax official Skill

evidence.claim: Reduce competing emotional beats inside one shot and split a dense performance across shots when the contract permits.
evidence.observed_scope: MiniMax H3 Ref2VA, 9:16, short serial-drama examples

evidence.claim: Establish camera side and a concrete gaze target before specifying facial direction and micro-expression.
Translate abstract emotion into observable gaze, eyelid, breath, shoulder, hand, or posture cues.
Hide large state changes behind eye closure, head movement, foreground occlusion, action occlusion, or a cut.
evidence.adoption: soft conditional guidance and experiment treatment

evidence.claim: Spoken dialogue consumes shot time and may conflict with simultaneous mouth or swallowing beats.

limitations: The source repository contains documentation but no runnable experiment code, raw prompts, raw videos, seeds, model build identifiers, or numeric result tables.
The observations do not establish a universal two-or-three-beat threshold.
Seedance 2.0 was not evaluated by the source.
Raw full-frame PSNR is not accepted as a proxy for facial acting quality.
Collision, liquid, exact crop, and transformation behavior remain content-, reference-, and model-dependent.
prohibited_overclaims: Do not describe this source as an official MiniMax Skill.
Do not claim the source findings are proven across models, aspect ratios, subjects, or providers.
Do not hard-ban collision, liquid, dialogue, transformation, or user-fixed shot density.
Do not report an experiment as completed unless paired artifacts, model metadata, hashes, and observations are present.
